blocks.text: CEBU, Philippines – Cebu is becoming a destination where there is always another reason to stay a little longer. From major concerts and sporting events to shopping, dining, leisure, and new experiences, visitors can now max out their Cebu experience by turning a trip to a show or tournament into a full day—or even a weekend—of discovering what the Queen City of the South has to offer. For SM Supermalls, this growing mix of experiences at SM Seaside City Cebu and across the complex adds another dimension to Cebu’s tourism story, giving both locals and visitors more reasons to come, stay, […]... Keep on reading: SM Seaside Cebu Arena creates new reasons to visit, stay, & experience Cebu
